description: Passengers (scripts/passengers.gd): the beds they sleep in and what each pays, the long-haul parties at the freight office, what a rough or late trip costs, and what they say. Local passengers are asked for in person (people.json, passenger). See docs/runtime/passengers.md.

long: Passage to %s, if you're going. We pack light and complain quietly.
My sister's in %s and she won't come to me. So.
I need to be in %s. I'm told your ship mostly arrives.
Contract work in %s. The company pays the fare, so I'd like the good bed.
cabin: We'd want a cabin. A door that shuts. We've done the bunk thing; we're past the bunk thing.
A cabin, please. I'm not sleeping where your engineer sleeps.
stateroom: A stateroom, naturally. I don't ask the price, so please don't tell me it.
The stateroom. And the viewport had better have stars in it.

bunk: Is this someone's bunk? It smells like someone's bunk.
I've slept in worse. Not recently.
The pillow has a name on it. It isn't mine.
cabin: Small, but the door locks. I've paid more for worse.
The viewport's the size of a plate. A nice plate.
We're fine. Are we nearly there? We're fine.
quarters: The lounge has a screen. It shows the same three films.
Someone's snoring in pod two. It's not me. It's never me.
Nice enough. The curtains don't quite meet.
stateroom: I asked for a window and got a window. Remarkable.
The plant's real. I checked. I always check.
Tell the captain the sheets are adequate. High praise.
late: I've started counting the rivets. There are a lot of rivets.
